name: Milk Bikis
ingredients:
REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (63%), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, MILK PRODUCTS (4%) [SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK MILK & MILK SOLIDS], INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii) & 500(i)], IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [322(i) & 471], MINERALS**, ARTIFICIAL [MILK & VANILLA] & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND VITAMINS*. (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) 
CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK AND SOY.
